about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I'm a Software Engineer specializing in backend systems, DevOps automation, and legacy modernization. Currently pursuing my Bachelor's in Software Engineering at Universidad Andrés Bello.
I've helped financial institutions like Citi Bank modernize critical payment systems, achieving 6x performance improvements and saving $36K+ in annual licensing costs through smart automation.

My toolkit spans .NET Core, Node.js, Python, React, and a deep understanding of CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, OpenShift, and AWS. I'm passionate about clean architecture, Domain-Driven Design, and building systems that scale.

description: Led rewrite of legacy .NET Framework apps into micro-frontend architecture (React + NestJS), achieving 6x performance improvement (30s → 5s)
Built CI/CD pipelines from scratch for 9 applications using Jenkins, TeamCity, Harness, and OpenShift
Eliminated $36K+ annual licensing costs by replacing PKWARE with native Windows tooling
Implemented testing framework achieving 80% code coverage for mission-critical payment systems (FlexCube ↔ BankCard)
Built full-stack agricultural platform: Vue.js dashboard, React Native mobile app, NestJS API, and Python ML services
Deployed microservices infrastructure on AWS ECS (6 containers including PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, and ML inference workers)
Developed computer vision pipeline with OpenCV + YOLOv5 for automated fruit quality classification
Assisted in developing web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks
Participated in code reviews and learned best practices for software development
Contributed to documentation and testing of existing applications
